spacing_review.reason: Separate شیخ from در when joining the source narrative across r00006 and r00007.
spacing_review.note: Accepted. Read against the two joined pieces: the left piece ends with شیخ and the right piece begins with در; شیخ is the subject and در آن کتاب فرموده is the rest of the sentence (the Shaykh said in that book), so without the space two words would run together. Checked by code point: the inserted character is U+0020 at index 3 of 409; a character that is not a space stands on each side of it; the field has no doubled space; and the mapped pieces of the two sources lie directly before and after it, so the space is the only character added. The row is Persian prose and has no Arabic field, so only this one space is in question.
